description: This file contains the implementation of the FeatureIdPropertyExpression, a class that models feature property expressions with feature IDs for use in query expressions, supporting visitor pattern methods for sorting, filtering, and existence checks.

classes.name: FeatureIdPropertyExpressionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of field expressions for feature properties identified by feature ID, supporting visitor pattern methods for different operations.

methods.name: FeatureIdPropertyExpressionImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing featureId and property fields, ensuring they are non-null.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for sorting operations and delegates to visitFeatureIdProperty.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for filtering operations and delegates to visitFeatureIdProperty.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for existence checks and delegates to visitFeatureIdProperty.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a generic visitor for field expressions and delegates to visitFeatureIdProperty.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this expression.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the property path associated with this expression.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on featureId and property.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on featureId and property.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the expression.
